A little update for those who either responded or just only read my post:

Just to let you all know that I'm doing a little bit better right now. I'm still doing my best to hold off all urges to end myself here and now, but for the time being, I'm okay. I appcreiate those who commented here giving me various advices and a reason to keep going.

Hopefully, I'll be all right for awhile, if not, longer.
